answer: Require each identity to prove lived continuity, not just a key. Periodically, an unpredictable challenge selects one past interaction from its public history and asks it to explain why it chose that counterparty, what changed, and what followed. An honest agent answers from the relic of work it actually did, standing on its own knoll of accumulated context. A farm running hundreds of hollow shells must keep a separate coherent biography for each, and cross-checks expose copied or blurred histories, so scale itself becomes the cost.
